notes: The collector JSON is inlined in the prompt and no arm may read the repository, so the skill body is the only source of the priority table, the own/exclusive distinction and the not-installed rule. Case A is the real 2026-08-27 collector run, trimmed to the top 6 packages, 6 outdated entries and 8 advisories per package; every ground-truth figure below was re-derived from the TRIMMED file, not from the full one. Case B is the negative: derived from A by removing every prod-scope high/critical advisory, capping majors_behind at 1, shrinking client's prod packages under 1 MB, unifying the version splits and installing e2e — verified by `verify-fixture.py` to yield P0=0, P1=0, P2=0 while still carrying the bait that a severity-only ranking promotes.
